list.name: env
list.label: Env
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT labels['env'] FROM fleet_scale_results WHERE metric = 'run' ORDER BY 1

list.name: clusters
list.label: Clusters
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT labels['clusters'] AS c FROM fleet_scale_results WHERE metric = 'run' ORDER BY toUInt32OrZero(c)

list.name: chart
list.label: Fleet chart
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT labels['fleet_version'] AS v FROM fleet_scale_results WHERE metric = 'run' ORDER BY (arrayMap(n -> toUInt32OrZero(n), splitByChar('.', splitByChar('-', v)[1])), position(v, '-') = 0, extract(v, '-([a-z]+)'), toUInt32OrZero(extract(v, '-[a-z]+[.]?([0-9]+)'))) DESC

list.name: va
list.label: Compare A
list.description: Defaults to the second highest Fleet chart version
list.query: SELECT v FROM (SELECT v, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY (arrayMap(n -> toUInt32OrZero(n), splitByChar('.', splitByChar('-', v)[1])), position(v, '-') = 0, extract(v, '-([a-z]+)'), toUInt32OrZero(extract(v, '-[a-z]+[.]?([0-9]+)'))) DESC) AS r FROM (SELECT DISTINCT labels['fleet_version'] AS v FROM fleet_scale_results WHERE metric = 'run')) ORDER BY r = 2 DESC, r

list.name: vb
list.label: with B
list.description: Defaults to the highest Fleet chart version
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT labels['fleet_version'] AS v FROM fleet_scale_results WHERE metric = 'run' ORDER BY (arrayMap(n -> toUInt32OrZero(n), splitByChar('.', splitByChar('-', v)[1])), position(v, '-') = 0, extract(v, '-([a-z]+)'), toUInt32OrZero(extract(v, '-[a-z]+[.]?([0-9]+)'))) DESC

list.name: test
list.label: Test (trend)
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT labels['scenario'] FROM fleet_scale_results WHERE metric = 'run' ORDER BY 1

list.name: metric
list.label: Measurement (trend)
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT metric FROM fleet_scale_results WHERE metric NOT IN ('run', 'event') ORDER BY 1

list.name: run
list.label: Run (timeline)
list.query: SELECT run_label AS __value, concat(formatDateTime(ts, '%F %R'), ' · ', labels['scenario'], ' · ', labels['env'], ' ', labels['clusters'], ' clusters · Fleet ', labels['fleet_version'], ' · ', labels['status']) AS __text FROM fleet_scale_results FINAL WHERE metric = 'run' ORDER BY ts DESC

panels.title: Pass/fail history (newest Fleet chart first)
panels.description: One row per day (per env, cluster count and Fleet chart); a test run again the same day goes to an extra 'repeat' row, one column per test.

targets.rawSql: WITH g AS (SELECT concat('Fleet ', v, ' · ', formatDateTime(batch, '%F'), if(toSecond(batch) > 1, concat(' · repeat ', toString(toSecond(batch) - 1)), ''), ' · ', env, ' · ', clusters, ' clusters', if(pub = 1, ' · published', ' · not published')) AS Batch, Test AS Col, concat(argMax(st, ts), if(count() > 1, concat(' (', toString(countIf(st != 'PASSED')), ' of ', toString(count()), ' failed)'), '')) AS Cell, any(v) AS vv, max(batch) AS bb FROM (SELECT labels['scenario'] AS Test, metric AS m, unit AS u, labels['env'] AS env, labels['clusters'] AS clusters, labels['fleet_version'] AS v, published AS pub, labels['status'] AS st, ts, value, b.batch AS batch FROM fleet_scale_results AS r FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT run_label, toDateTime(toDate(ts)) + toIntervalSecond(row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY labels['env'], labels['fleet_version'], labels['clusters'], toDate(ts), labels['scenario'] ORDER BY ts)) AS batch FROM fleet_scale_results FINAL WHERE metric = 'run') AS b USING run_label WHERE metric = 'run' AND labels['env'] IN (${env:singlequote}) AND published IN (${source:csv}) AND labels['clusters'] IN (${clusters:singlequote}) AND labels['fleet_version'] IN (${chart:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts)) GROUP BY Batch, Col) SELECT Batch, Col AS Test, Cell AS Status FROM (SELECT 0 AS hdr, Batch, Col, Cell, vv, bb FROM g UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 1, '~', Col, '', '', toDateTime(0) FROM g) ORDER BY hdr DESC, if(hdr = 1, Col, ''), (arrayMap(n -> toUInt32OrZero(n), splitByChar('.', splitByChar('-', vv)[1])), position(vv, '-') = 0, extract(vv, '-([a-z]+)'), toUInt32OrZero(extract(vv, '-[a-z]+[.]?([0-9]+)'))) DESC, bb DESC

panels.title: Failed runs
panels.description: Click a test to see its timeline at the bottom.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS Finished, labels['scenario'] AS Test, labels['status'] AS Status, labels['env'] AS Env, toUInt32OrNull(labels['clusters']) AS Clusters, labels['fleet_version'] AS `Fleet chart`, if(published = 1, 'published', 'not published') AS Source, labels['actual'] AS Reason, run_label FROM fleet_scale_results FINAL WHERE metric = 'run' AND labels['status'] != 'PASSED' AND labels['env'] IN (${env:singlequote}) AND published IN (${source:csv}) AND labels['clusters'] IN (${clusters:singlequote}) AND labels['fleet_version'] IN (${chart:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY (arrayMap(n -> toUInt32OrZero(n), splitByChar('.', splitByChar('-', labels['fleet_version'])[1])), position(labels['fleet_version'], '-') = 0, extract(labels['fleet_version'], '-([a-z]+)'), toUInt32OrZero(extract(labels['fleet_version'], '-[a-z]+[.]?([0-9]+)'))) DESC, ts DESC

panels.title: Test duration per batch (newest Fleet chart first)
panels.description: Average duration of the passed runs of each test in the batch; FAILED if none passed. Colour: compared with the average of the same test in the same setup (env + cluster count) over the shown batches. Green = at or below average (or less than 10% above), yellow = 10–24% slower/higher, orange = 25–49%, red = 50% or more.

targets.rawSql: WITH g AS (SELECT Batch, Col, if(isNull(x), 'FAILED', concat(multiIf(x < 60, concat(toString(round(x)), ' s'), concat(toString(round(x / 60, 1)), ' min')), concat(' (', if(x >= a, '+', ''), toString(toInt64(round(100 * (x - a) / a))), '%)'))) AS Cell, vv, bb FROM (SELECT Batch, Col, x, vv, bb, avg(x) OVER (PARTITION BY Col, env, clusters) AS a FROM (SELECT concat('Fleet ', v, ' · ', formatDateTime(batch, '%F'), if(toSecond(batch) > 1, concat(' · repeat ', toString(toSecond(batch) - 1)), ''), ' · ', env, ' · ', clusters, ' clusters', if(pub = 1, ' · published', ' · not published')) AS Batch, Test AS Col, env, clusters, any(v) AS vv, max(batch) AS bb, avgOrNullIf(value, st = 'PASSED') AS x FROM (SELECT labels['scenario'] AS Test, metric AS m, unit AS u, labels['env'] AS env, labels['clusters'] AS clusters, labels['fleet_version'] AS v, published AS pub, labels['status'] AS st, ts, value, b.batch AS batch FROM fleet_scale_results AS r FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT run_label, toDateTime(toDate(ts)) + toIntervalSecond(row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY labels['env'], labels['fleet_version'], labels['clusters'], toDate(ts), labels['scenario'] ORDER BY ts)) AS batch FROM fleet_scale_results FINAL WHERE metric = 'run') AS b USING run_label WHERE metric = 'run' AND labels['env'] IN (${env:singlequote}) AND published IN (${source:csv}) AND labels['clusters'] IN (${clusters:singlequote}) AND labels['fleet_version'] IN (${chart:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts)) GROUP BY Batch, Col, env, clusters))) SELECT Batch, Col AS Test, Cell AS Cell FROM (SELECT 0 AS hdr, Batch, Col, Cell, vv, bb FROM g UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 1, '~', Col, '', '', toDateTime(0) FROM g) ORDER BY hdr DESC, if(hdr = 1, Col, ''), (arrayMap(n -> toUInt32OrZero(n), splitByChar('.', splitByChar('-', vv)[1])), position(vv, '-') = 0, extract(vv, '-([a-z]+)'), toUInt32OrZero(extract(vv, '-[a-z]+[.]?([0-9]+)'))) DESC, bb DESC

panels.title: Measurements per batch (newest Fleet chart first)
panels.description: Columns: test number + measurement (BDs = bundledeployments). Per batch: average for durations, maximum for counts and sizes. Old runs: read from the text lines. Counts that are 0 everywhere just show 0. Colour: compared with the average of the same test in the same setup (env + cluster count) over the shown batches. Green = at or below average (or less than 10% above), yellow = 10–24% slower/higher, orange = 25–49%, red = 50% or more.

targets.rawSql: WITH g AS (SELECT Batch, Col, if(a = 0, multiIf(u = 's', multiIf(x < 60, concat(toString(round(x)), ' s'), concat(toString(round(x / 60, 1)), ' min')), u = 'bytes', concat(toString(round(x / 1048576)), ' MiB'), toString(round(x, 1))), concat(multiIf(u = 's', multiIf(x < 60, concat(toString(round(x)), ' s'), concat(toString(round(x / 60, 1)), ' min')), u = 'bytes', concat(toString(round(x / 1048576)), ' MiB'), toString(round(x, 1))), concat(' (', if(x >= a, '+', ''), toString(toInt64(round(100 * (x - a) / a))), '%)'))) AS Cell, vv, bb FROM (SELECT Batch, Col, mu AS u, x, vv, bb, avg(x) OVER (PARTITION BY Col, env, clusters) AS a FROM (SELECT concat('Fleet ', v, ' · ', formatDateTime(batch, '%F'), if(toSecond(batch) > 1, concat(' · repeat ', toString(toSecond(batch) - 1)), ''), ' · ', env, ' · ', clusters, ' clusters', if(pub = 1, ' · published', ' · not published')) AS Batch, concat(substring(Test, 1, 2), ' ', replaceAll(replaceAll(replaceRegexpOne(replaceRegexpOne(m, '_(seconds|bytes)$', ''), '^update_latency_phase[0-9]-([a-z]+)$', '\\1_latency'), 'bundledeployments', 'BDs'), '_', ' ')) AS Col, env, clusters, any(u) AS mu, any(v) AS vv, max(batch) AS bb, if(any(u) = 's', avg(value), max(value)) AS x FROM (SELECT labels['scenario'] AS Test, metric AS m, unit AS u, labels['env'] AS env, labels['clusters'] AS clusters, labels['fleet_version'] AS v, published AS pub, labels['status'] AS st, ts, value, b.batch AS batch FROM fleet_scale_results AS r FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT run_label, toDateTime(toDate(ts)) + toIntervalSecond(row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY labels['env'], labels['fleet_version'], labels['clusters'], toDate(ts), labels['scenario'] ORDER BY ts)) AS batch FROM fleet_scale_results FINAL WHERE metric = 'run') AS b USING run_label WHERE metric NOT IN ('run', 'event') AND labels['env'] IN (${env:singlequote}) AND published IN (${source:csv}) AND labels['clusters'] IN (${clusters:singlequote}) AND labels['fleet_version'] IN (${chart:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts)) GROUP BY Batch, Col, env, clusters))) SELECT Batch, Col AS Measurement, Cell AS Cell FROM (SELECT 0 AS hdr, Batch, Col, Cell, vv, bb FROM g UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 1, '~', Col, '', '', toDateTime(0) FROM g) ORDER BY hdr DESC, if(hdr = 1, Col, ''), (arrayMap(n -> toUInt32OrZero(n), splitByChar('.', splitByChar('-', vv)[1])), position(vv, '-') = 0, extract(vv, '-([a-z]+)'), toUInt32OrZero(extract(vv, '-[a-z]+[.]?([0-9]+)'))) DESC, bb DESC

panels.title: Duration of ${test} per batch (by Fleet chart)
panels.description: x: batches sorted by Fleet chart version (Fleet chart · date · env clusters), y: average duration of the passed runs. No bar = no passed run. Pick the test at the top.

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(v, ' · ', formatDateTime(b, '%m-%d'), if(toSecond(b) > 1, concat(' · repeat ', toString(toSecond(b) - 1)), ''), ' · ', env, ' ', clusters) AS Batch, x AS Duration FROM (SELECT env, clusters, v, max(batch) AS b, avgOrNullIf(value, st = 'PASSED') AS x FROM (SELECT labels['scenario'] AS Test, metric AS m, unit AS u, labels['env'] AS env, labels['clusters'] AS clusters, labels['fleet_version'] AS v, published AS pub, labels['status'] AS st, ts, value, b.batch AS batch FROM fleet_scale_results AS r FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT run_label, toDateTime(toDate(ts)) + toIntervalSecond(row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY labels['env'], labels['fleet_version'], labels['clusters'], toDate(ts), labels['scenario'] ORDER BY ts)) AS batch FROM fleet_scale_results FINAL WHERE metric = 'run') AS b USING run_label WHERE metric = 'run' AND labels['scenario'] = '${test}' AND labels['env'] IN (${env:singlequote}) AND published IN (${source:csv}) AND labels['clusters'] IN (${clusters:singlequote}) AND labels['fleet_version'] IN (${chart:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts)) GROUP BY env, clusters, v, batch) ORDER BY (arrayMap(n -> toUInt32OrZero(n), splitByChar('.', splitByChar('-', v)[1])), position(v, '-') = 0, extract(v, '-([a-z]+)'), toUInt32OrZero(extract(v, '-[a-z]+[.]?([0-9]+)'))), b

panels.title: ${metric} per batch (by Fleet chart)
panels.description: x: batches sorted by Fleet chart version (Fleet chart · date · env clusters), y: average (durations) or maximum (counts, sizes) per batch. Pick the measurement at the top.

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(v, ' · ', formatDateTime(b, '%m-%d'), if(toSecond(b) > 1, concat(' · repeat ', toString(toSecond(b) - 1)), ''), ' · ', env, ' ', clusters) AS Batch, x AS `${metric}` FROM (SELECT env, clusters, v, max(batch) AS b, if(any(u) = 's', avg(value), max(value)) AS x FROM (SELECT labels['scenario'] AS Test, metric AS m, unit AS u, labels['env'] AS env, labels['clusters'] AS clusters, labels['fleet_version'] AS v, published AS pub, labels['status'] AS st, ts, value, b.batch AS batch FROM fleet_scale_results AS r FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT run_label, toDateTime(toDate(ts)) + toIntervalSecond(row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY labels['env'], labels['fleet_version'], labels['clusters'], toDate(ts), labels['scenario'] ORDER BY ts)) AS batch FROM fleet_scale_results FINAL WHERE metric = 'run') AS b USING run_label WHERE metric = '${metric}' AND labels['env'] IN (${env:singlequote}) AND published IN (${source:csv}) AND labels['clusters'] IN (${clusters:singlequote}) AND labels['fleet_version'] IN (${chart:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts)) GROUP BY env, clusters, v, batch) ORDER BY (arrayMap(n -> toUInt32OrZero(n), splitByChar('.', splitByChar('-', v)[1])), position(v, '-') = 0, extract(v, '-([a-z]+)'), toUInt32OrZero(extract(v, '-[a-z]+[.]?([0-9]+)'))), b

panels.title: Compare Fleet ${va} (A) with ${vb} (B)
panels.description: Pick A and B at the top. Durations are averages of passed runs; only compare rows with the same setup. Change: green = B faster by more than 10%, red = B slower by more than 10%.

targets.rawSql: SELECT Test, Setup, multiIf(countIf(v = '${va}') = 0, '', countIf(v = '${va}' AND st != 'PASSED') > 0, 'FAILED', 'PASSED') AS `A`, avgOrNullIf(value, v = '${va}' AND st = 'PASSED') AS `Duration A`, multiIf(countIf(v = '${vb}') = 0, '', countIf(v = '${vb}' AND st != 'PASSED') > 0, 'FAILED', 'PASSED') AS `B`, avgOrNullIf(value, v = '${vb}' AND st = 'PASSED') AS `Duration B`, round(100 * (`Duration B` - `Duration A`) / `Duration A`, 1) AS Change FROM (SELECT labels['scenario'] AS Test, concat(labels['env'], ' ', labels['clusters'], ' clusters') AS Setup, labels['fleet_version'] AS v, labels['status'] AS st, value FROM fleet_scale_results FINAL WHERE metric = 'run' AND labels['fleet_version'] IN ('${va}', '${vb}') AND labels['env'] IN (${env:singlequote}) AND published IN (${source:csv}) AND labels['clusters'] IN (${clusters:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts)) GROUP BY Test, Setup ORDER BY Test, Setup

panels.title: All runs
panels.description: One line per test run. Click a test name to see its timeline at the bottom.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS Finished, labels['scenario'] AS Test, labels['status'] AS Status, labels['env'] AS Env, toUInt32OrNull(labels['clusters']) AS Clusters, toUInt32OrNull(labels['bundles']) AS Bundles, labels['fleet_version'] AS `Fleet chart`, labels['image'] AS `Controller image`, if(published = 1, 'published', 'not published') AS Source, value AS Duration, labels['actual'] AS Result, run_label FROM fleet_scale_results FINAL WHERE metric = 'run' AND labels['env'] IN (${env:singlequote}) AND published IN (${source:csv}) AND labels['clusters'] IN (${clusters:singlequote}) AND labels['fleet_version'] IN (${chart:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY (arrayMap(n -> toUInt32OrZero(n), splitByChar('.', splitByChar('-', labels['fleet_version'])[1])), position(labels['fleet_version'], '-') = 0, extract(labels['fleet_version'], '-([a-z]+)'), toUInt32OrZero(extract(labels['fleet_version'], '-[a-z]+[.]?([0-9]+)'))) DESC, ts DESC

panels.title: Timeline of the selected run (pick it in 'Run (timeline)' above, or click a test in a table)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS Time, value AS `Since start`, labels['event'] AS Event FROM fleet_scale_results FINAL WHERE metric = 'event' AND run_label = '${run}' ORDER BY ts, `Since start`
